rationale: V1 accepts integer or half-step scores on the 1-5 hook/prose scale. A 0.1 variance ceiling rejects every full one-point disagreement because two scores one point apart have variance 0.25, while allowing one half-step difference because variance is 0.0625. The frozen 816-score review observed maxVariance 0, so this policy passed the recorded evidence without a post-hoc threshold change.

onExceeded.identify: sample-and-dimension pairs whose reviewer score variance exceeds the approved threshold
onExceeded.routeTo: adjudication or an additional independent reviewer
onExceeded.rerun: rerun the full quality and release gate after resolution
onExceeded.waiver: not allowed for the V1 quality claim

completionTimeWarningDecision.rationale: 接受为残余 warning。两名评审人的 reviewedAt/submittedAt 表示同批次的提交时间，而非经记录的实际评审耗时；独立评分声明、64/204 个 hook confidence 差异和不同的 retained concerns 提供辅助证据。408/408 配对同分不作为独立评审的证明，cleanBlindReview 仍为 false，该 warning 继续保留。
